corrected_claim: On 21 Sep 2022 (11:30 PM IST) the US Fed announced a 75 basis point rate hike and Powell's press conference (~45 min) was hawkish; the S&P 500 fell about 1.7% (roughly 66 points to ~3,789), Dow -522 (-1.7%), Nasdaq -1.8%, with the drop accelerating into the close after an intraday recovery.

notes: Mauritius tax-treaty amendment reports in April 2024 were a real FPI sentiment trigger (Finshots, BS, Moneycontrol).
